data.name: Nujaid
data.gender_notes: Nujaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'najada' which means 'to help, aid or support'. This name signifies generosity, kindness and a willingness to help others. In Islamic history, it is associated with the virtues of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions. The name Nujaid carries the meaning “Helpful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nujaid usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
